definitions.explanation: An official search or inquiry, especially by police to solve crimes.

examples.japanese: {警察|けいさつ}は{事件|じけん}の{捜査|そうさ}を{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: The police are continuing the investigation of the case.

examples.japanese: {捜査|そうさ}の{結果|けっか}、{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}が{逮捕|たいほ}された。
examples.english: As a result of the investigation, a suspect was arrested.

examples.japanese: {捜査|そうさ}{当局|とうきょく}は{証拠|しょうこ}を{集|あつ}めている。
examples.english: The investigative authorities are gathering evidence.

notes:
Specifically refers to criminal investigations by law enforcement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{捜査|そうさ}する (to investigate)
・{捜査|そうさ}{当局|とうきょく} (investigative authorities)
・{捜査|そうさ}{本部|ほんぶ} (investigation headquarters)
・{捜査|そうさ}{員|いん} (investigator)
・{捜査|そうさ}{線上|せんじょう} (under investigation)

HOMOPHONE:
・{操作|そうさ} - operation, manipulation (of machines, data)
